pull.title: sql: add exponential backoff to schema change job retries
pull.body:
Previously, the schema changer job retried failed steps immediately and indefinitely, which hot-looped and burned CPU when a descriptor was offline.

This change retries schema change jobs with exponential backoff, capped by a new cluster setting `schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff` (default 20s). We chose a capped exponential backoff rather than a fixed retry interval because a fixed interval either retries too aggressively during long outages or too slowly after short ones.

Fixes #98001
Informs #97000

Release note (bug fix): Schema change jobs no longer retry in a tight loop when a descriptor is offline.

reviews.body: Should the cap be a cluster setting rather than a constant? Operators may need to tune it during an incident.
LGTM. Capping the backoff at 20 seconds keeps a stuck job visible in SHOW JOBS without hammering the cluster.

review_comments.body: nit: log the error at warning level so it shows up in the job's trace.
